raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary

Fix two CI failures in the CUDA graph topology sample:

- Use `fe::get_environment` for `CUDNN186_LOG`, avoiding MSVC C4996 under `/WX`.
- Count only top-level frontend nodes in the SDPA alibi eligibility check and its log. Recursive counts include backend child-graph memsets and can fail `memsets == 0` even when the frontend adds no memset. Keep the checks for one frontend copy, no frontend memset, and one backend child graph.

## Before submitting

- [x] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt).
- [x] I ran `pre-commit run` and committed any formatting changes.
- [x] I reviewed the Hard Rules in the applicable `AGENTS.md` files.
- [x] I added the required category, area, and origin labels.

## Affected area

Documentation or samples; CI or test infrastructure.

## Why

Frontend eligibility depends on frontend workspace operations. Backend graph contents vary by selected plan and must not affect the frontend node-count assertions.

## Related issues

Follow-up to #1140.

## API and compatibility impact

None.

## Testing

- `pre-commit run --files samples/cpp/misc/cudagraph_topology.cpp`: passed.
- `cmake --build /tmp/cudnn-ci-498307/build --target samples -j 12`: passed with warnings treated as errors.
- `build/bin/samples "186 eligibility comes from node-producing frontend workspace operations"`: passed, 12 assertions.
- Local GPU validation used SM100, CUDA 13.2, and cuDNN 9.28. Windows and H100 CI still need validation.


<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Bug Fixes**
  * Updated CUDA graph topology validation to accurately count top-level memory-copy, memory-set, and child-graph nodes.
  * Improved environment-based logging configuration handling.
  * Clarified eligibility-case documentation for SDPA alibi topology checks.

<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
